effects.text: Never Dying, Doomed, Injured or Soul Drain.

warps.text: Transfer one additional point of the same condition

system.description:
HEALING SOUL UTILITY
Tradition divinity
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Range touch
Targets 1 willing creature

You take a fragment of another creature's suffering into yourself.
Choose one of the following conditions affecting the target: Dazed, Fatigued, Frightened, Sickened or Weakened.
Reduce the selected condition by 1. You immediately gain or increase the same condition by 1.
If you are immune to the selected condition, or another effect would prevent you from receiving it, Share Burden fails. This spell cannot transfer Dying, Doomed, Injured or Soul Drain.

Warping Options:
+2 PP: Transfer one additional point of the same condition.
+2 PP: Increase the range to 30 feet.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10. The relief row offers which of the target's conditions to take down by 1; you then gain or increase the same condition by 1 yourself, on the card (an immunity refuses it).
